hero.title: The design layer for AI-driven software.
hero.description: Stop letting AI hallucinate your UI. Tulip pairs strict Taste Governance with real-time Model Context Protocol (MCP) streaming, pushing human-approved design tokens and component blocks directly into your AI IDE.

metrics.manifestoText: AI can build a React app in an afternoon, but it can't remember your brand. Agencies take five weeks to fix that with wireframes. Tulip does it in 48 hours by giving your AI the exact tokens and components it's allowed to use, then checking every screen before it ships.

bundle.title: A handoff your engineers can build on
bundle.description: A Figma file, a React repo and coded layouts that match each other exactly, so your team can start wiring up the backend the same day.

items.title: Master Figma System
items.description: One Figma file where every color, spacing value and type style is a named variable, so nobody can drift off-system.

items.title: Production React Repo
items.description: The same components as the Figma file, built in React for Next.js and checked for accessibility before handoff.

items.title: High-Legibility Typography
items.description: A type scale tuned for dense screens, so tables, charts and dashboards stay readable at small sizes.

items.title: Native Iconography
items.description: Custom SVG icons made for your product, in place of the open-source set every other app uses.

items.title: The 48-Hour Handoff
items.description: 48 hours after your brief, you get the Master Figma file, a synced GitHub repo and your coded page layouts, ready for your backend engineers.

sprintWorkflow.title: Zero agency bloat. Pure execution.
sprintWorkflow.description: Stop waiting weeks for wireframes and endless feedback loops. Give us your technical constraints and deploy your React codebase in 48h.

cards.title: Five minutes to capture your UI DNA
cards.description: Skip the open-ended prompts. Our 5-minute brief asks for your primary hex codes, a layout archetype and a checklist of the features you need.

cards.title: Governed by taste. Compiled by AI.
cards.description: We don't blindly ship AI drafts. Our engine maps your brief to an Intermediate UI Representation (UIR). An agent audits the visual tokens, confirms the Figma variables match the repository, and verifies WCAG accessibility before handoff.

engine.title: Three guardrails for AI-built UI
engine.description: We force AI to use your actual Lego bricks, not invent new ones.

features.title: Taste Governance Engine
features.description: Automated optical checks, contrast audits, and design-system drift prevention before code is ever published.

features.title: Real-Time MCP Sync
features.description: Direct integration with mcp.usetulip.co, letting Cursor and local AI coding assistants stream approved layouts and brand tokens dynamically.

features.title: Production React & Figma Alignment
features.description: Guaranteed 1:1 token synchronization between your Master Figma files, Drizzle/Supabase database schema, and Next.js repositories.

pricing.title: One Flat Fee
pricing.description: Fixed monthly pricing. Pick the plan that matches how much of your frontend you want governed.

ctaBanner.title: Ready to fix your frontend bottleneck?
ctaBanner.description: Stop wasting engineering cycles on padding and hex codes. Get back to finding product-market fit.
